verdict.rationale: Working Copy's mobile app includes a conversational Repository Agent that can browse, search, read and modify files, and commit, pull and push (working-copy-docs-29). It also offers AI-generated commit message suggestions based on staged diffs (working-copy-docs-5, working-copy-docs-37). So an AI could plausibly review code on a checked-out branch, but nothing documents the agent reading pull requests or producing code-review suggestions, and the only PR-adjacent item (working-copy-docs-19) is an ambiguous mention of creating something on hosting services. Missing for 10: documented AI analysis of pull requests or PR diffs, code-review or improvement suggestions from the agent, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of the Repository Agent.
